extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.24 - Live TV no longer freezes BingeTV when Dispatcharr is slow; Home trailers have sound; the info page's trailer plays full screen; a show played through two catalogs is one entry in Continue Watching. v0.17.23 - BingeTV: Home trailers are found in the background, so the remote keeps working while one starts (with BingeTV 0.2.5). v0.17.22 - BingeTV: Home trailers play in YouTube's screensaver mode (with BingeTV 0.2.5, a direct stream: no hang when an info page opens mid-trailer). v0.17.21 - BingeTV: Home trailers wake YouTube when it has gone idle, so they play after a pause too. v0.17.20 - BingeTV: no volume icon when a muted trailer starts or stops. v0.17.19 - BingeTV: hub pages laid out like Home, with trailers; the info page uses Home's centred layout with chips. v0.17.18 - BingeTV: minimal chips; the description shows at 2 seconds and stays while a trailer loads. v0.17.17 - BingeTV: the focused title in a centred column, with its date, length, rating and genres as chips and its description after 2 seconds.
